adversarial_audit.objection: Exponentially many outcomes force the noncrossing term to vanish.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The relevant ratio is r/N, already bounded below by 19/520; the number of coordinate blocks does not enter equation (1).

adversarial_audit.objection: A positive noncrossing term proves noncommutativity.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False. Uniform scalar and orthogonal projective controls attain the lower bound while commuting; crossing equals noncrossing.

adversarial_audit.objection: Trace balance or a Jacobi edge is hidden in the proof.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Weighted Cauchy uses only sum_e Tr(H_e)=r and sum_e b_e=N.

adversarial_audit.objection: The total lower bound automatically lower-bounds distinct pairs.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False. The orthogonal projective control has zero distinct-pair noncrossing mass and puts the entire total moment on e=f.

claim_gate.reason: The total noncrossing term has a constant natural floor, but its same-outcome part cancels exactly and can contain the full floor.

falsifiers_triggered: The natural total noncrossing scale is not an open spectral-edge problem.
A positive noncrossing lower bound alone cannot distinguish scalar or projective commuting POVMs.
Any remaining M4 proof must force distinct-pair noncrossing mass and control its crossing partner.

natural_corollary.statement: Conditioned on globally distinct sources, at least 1/9-o(1) mass has total noncrossing physical moment at least 6859/34611200-o(1); the unconditional conditioned-law expectation is at least 6859/311500800-o(1). Same-outcome mass may account for this entire floor and cancels from component M4.

proof_obligations.resolution: Coordinate rank plus two Cauchy inequalities and the proved final-root aspect event give a constant physical lower bound.
The proof uses only ranks, total coefficient dimension, and common-fiber aspects; arbitrarily small positive eigenvalues are allowed.
The total floor can be entirely diagonal, as the sharp orthogonal-PVM control demonstrates. A natural incidence or overlap theorem must force off-diagonal mass.
After e=f cancellation, compare the two distinct-leaf word sums under canonical normalization.

summary: Proved a sharp total noncrossing scale and showed why dimensions alone cannot lower-bound the distinct-pair component-M4 contribution.

theorem.sharpness: Equality holds for uniform scalar coordinate compressions and orthogonal projective measurements.
